title: filenode: send withheld properties as null for discoverable-but-unreadable nodes
description: From decision 47's implementation: filenode-20 L1294 says a node the user can discover but not read returns only id, @type, name, parentId, myRights, isSubscribed, shareWith, others null. The memory backend omits them instead (and File still shows default mediaType/executable). Needs a pass in the FileNode /get handler so it is backend-independent.
close_reason: Done in 3ff470de: FileNode/get nulls withheld properties of unreadable nodes in the handler (backend-independent), marks them unreadable for conditional; changes no longer reports hidden-only updates to sharees; copy of unreadable source tested forbidden. Residual: a backend returning unblanked values could reveal role via the copy handler's role-conflict check.
